name: quidot-motion-choreography
description: Playful shape-morphing and elastic micro-choreography add-on for Web (React/Framer Motion) and Mobile/Desktop (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose), inspired by quidot/yui. Strictly agnostic to colors, static geometry, and materials—designed to layer cleanly on top of `apple-ui-principles` or any existing design system. Use when components need expressive stretching, vector path deflection, coupled drag follow-through, or morphing state transitions across Web or Compose.
